product.title: The Front Office Dashboard — Data to Decisions
product.summary: Draft nine players under a cap and an owner mandate, then simulate the season.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students draft a nine-player roster under a cap with a luxury-tax trigger, spending eight scout tokens to reveal hidden data, while a randomly assigned owner mandate re-weights what the efficiency score rewards. A season then simulates with injuries and breakouts and economics questions interleaved.

studentDataProfile.notes: State kept in browser localStorage only; no server call observed.

governance.maturityBasis: The most feature-dense single-file lesson in the account, publicly reachable, with a persistent leaderboard. No student-run evidence exists.
